content: Dependency-free deterministic harness pattern: fake clock is the keystone (advance(ms) drives Date.now, timers, rAF); inject environment (MutationObserver, document, window, media element) into the engine via options object so the IIFE is pure. FakeMutationObserver records records and flushes synchronously on advance(); FakeVideoElement implements playbackRate/volume/muted/loop/paused/play()/pause()/ended/addEventListener. Tiny assert runner: test(name, fn) + assert.equal/ok; results to DOM table. Runs in plain browser page via <script> tags, no build step, no framework; also Node-runnable since mocks are pure JS.
